verdict.rationale: gstack is distributed via git-clone install and runs locally against your own repos/agents (git-clone-and-copy install model, dev mode symlinking repo into local skills dir), implying self-hosting of the core skill files rather than a hosted SaaS dependency, and telemetry callback to the vendor is noted by community. However there's no explicit self-hosting documentation (server components, deployment guide, data residency) or confirmation that all functionality runs fully offline/self-hosted without vendor telemetry. missing for 10: explicit self-hosting/deployment docs, confirmation no mandatory vendor telemetry/backend dependency, independent verification of full offline operation.
